sentence: This project builds a platform that uses mass spectrometry to identify lipids in detail and to learn what lipids do in biological systems.
This project studies how microorganisms form biofilms, which are resilient communities of microbial cells, and how these communities are regulated and built.
This project provides linguistic support, such as medical interpreting and translation, for cancer research and community outreach.
This project plans and tracks the goals of a cancer center, using advice from internal and external advisors to guide its next steps.
This project studies how positive and negative reinforcement affect cannabis use in young adults as cannabis use disorder develops.
This project uses computers to design small, stable proteins that act as antivirals against highly pathogenic viruses.
This project tries to find out how a fusion drives epigenetic and metabolic pathways in childhood ependymomas, a brain cancer.
This project holds a workshop where participants design, build and use low-field MRI systems with open-source methods.
This project studies how ferroptosis works at the molecular level and how it connects to lipid metabolism in cancer.
This project develops statistical and machine learning methods that combine data from multiple sources to understand disease and find biomarkers.
This project studies why leukemia cells resist drugs, using a test that measures how ready cells are to undergo cell death.
This project studies how iron builds up around electrodes implanted in the brain and tests whether iron chelation can protect them.
This project tests whether a transcription factor helps the human urothelium defend against urinary tract infections.
This project studies how a proton-activated chloride channel senses its environment, which matters for brain damage after ischemic stroke.
This project uses human genetics to study how genes cause morningness and eveningness and how they relate to diabetes.
This project uses a rat model to study how fentanyl use changes the brain circuits that control risk taking.
This project uses clinical and multi-omics data to predict survival and complications early in preterm infants.
This project tests whether boosting lysosomal proteases in neurons helps clear a protein that builds up in the brains of patients with amyotrophic lateral sclerosis.
This project develops nanoscale coordination polymers as a drug candidate for immunotherapy of metastatic colorectal cancer.
This project builds deep learning models to sharpen and outline cortical and hippocampal layers in MRI to study degeneration in Alzheimers disease.
